findings.title: Error from a.Invalidate silently ignored
findings.message: The error returned by a.Invalidate("one") is discarded with _ = inside the Do closure. This file exists to exercise focus behavior across offscreen redraw cycles, and the Invalidate call is what triggers that redraw; if it fails (e.g., unknown window, invalidation refused), the redraw never happens and the remaining assertions can pass while never testing the scenario the test was written for.
findings.suggestion: Capture the error and fail on it after a.Do returns (do not call t.Fatal from inside the Do closure if it may run on another goroutine): var invErr error; if err := a.Do(func() { invErr = a.Invalidate("one") }); err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }; if invErr != nil { t.Fatal(invErr) }
